description: This file is a shell script for initializing and downloading the Gradle wrapper in the Apache OFBiz project. It verifies the environment, downloads necessary files, and checks their integrity.

methods.name: whereIsBinary
methods.description: Finds the path of a binary executable in the system.

methods.name: downloadFile
methods.description: Downloads a file using curl or wget, depending on availability.

methods.name: resolveFile
methods.description: Downloads a file from the main Gradle wrapper URI.
